## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Sekhiya 19 (*Sīsappacālaka*, "Swaying the head") is a monastic training rule situated within the *Sekhiya* chapter of the Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga in the Pali Vinaya Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. The rule regulates bodily comportment, specifically instructing monastics against swaying or tossing the head when moving or sitting within inhabited areas [SuttaCentral]. On SuttaCentral, modern translations include an English translation by Bhikkhu Brahmali [SuttaCentral].
This training rule reflects standard ancient Buddhist etiquette and is widely preserved across early Buddhist schools. Curated parallels on SuttaCentral document corresponding rules across multiple Vinaya lineages, including the Pali Bhikkhu Pātimokkha (Sk 19), Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga (Sk 19), Bhikkhunī Pātimokkha (Sk 19), and both Bhikkhu and Bhikkhunī Parivāra [SuttaCentral]. Closely aligned regulations appear in the Vinayas of the Sarvāstivāda (e.g., Chinese Bu Vb Sk 47 and Sanskrit Prātimokṣa manuscripts), Mūlasarvāstivāda (extant in Chinese, Tibetan, and Sanskrit), Mahīśāsaka (Chinese Bu Vb Sk 21), Mahāsāṅghika and Mahāsāṅghika-Lokottaravāda (Chinese and Sanskrit Sk 12), Kāśyapīya, and the *Upāliparipṛcchā* [SuttaCentral].
Automated analysis by DharmaNexus identifies 128 Pali-internal text-reuse matches across 47 other Pali texts, reflecting the highly stereotyped narrative frame, formulation, and case definitions shared throughout the *Sekhiya* group [DharmaNexus]. Its closest matches within the Pali canon include neighboring bodily etiquette rules such as Sekhiya 16, Sekhiya 18, Sekhiya 9, Sekhiya 14, and Sekhiya 11 [DharmaNexus]. No cross-language matches in DharmaNexus met the reporting threshold [DharmaNexus]. The citations retrieved in the secondary literature dossier exclusively refer to verse 19 of the Brahmanical philosophical text *Sāṃkhyakārikā* (SK 19) rather than this Vinaya training rule.
